restorations.before: Gating layers, squeeze-and-excitation blocks, and attention multiply activations entrywise or contract tensors. The sign-sorted construction of \textcite{hiddenMono} preserves the difference and monotonicity of non-negative stream pairs. restorations.after: In this section we lay the theoretical foundation to split neural networks that contain non-additive components such as gating, SE-blocks or attention modules. These require matrix multiplication and Hadamard product layers. The sign-sorted construction of \textcite{hiddenMono} preserves the difference and monotonicity on non-negative split inputs; Section~\ref{sec:transformer_dc} adds convexity using Chapter~\ref{ch:decompositions}'s multivariate softmax pair.

restorations.before: Induct in topological order on the non-negative orthant. Coordinate projections are posynomials; non-negative scaling, addition and maxima preserve finite maxima of posynomials. Products of non-negative factors distribute over finite maxima, covering every network operation.
